org.ddolib.common.util.debug

Packages that use org.ddolib.common.util.debug
Package
Description
org.ddolib.common.util.debug
This package contains util stuff related to the debug mode common to all model.
org.ddolib.layered.modeling
This package contains the interfaces and abstract classes that must be implemented as problem specific classes to model a problem with the layered API (fixed, known number of variables).
org.ddolib.layered.solving.ddo.core.compilation
This package contains CompilationConfig, which bundles everything needed to compile a layered decision diagram (the CompilationType, dominance checker, cache, cut-set type, clustering strategy, variable heuristic and modeling pieces).
org.ddolib.nolayer.modeling
This package contains the interfaces and abstract classes that must be implemented as problem specific classes to model a problem with the no-layer API (no fixed number of variables, termination detected via Problem.isTarget(Object)).
